- Class is ORGANIC, but the curve shows 75.6% bundle share, which means most early supply was bundled and the "organic" label is doubtful.
- Price is down 38.5% from the 30-minute high, with a 10.8% drop over the last 15 minutes and net outflow of 19.3 SOL.
- Sell-to-buy ratio of 1.12 right after graduation, with a launch bot present.
- Pool depth of 157.75 SOL means a $20 round trip would eat a meaningful share of the 1.4-5.1% cost band, and exits in a falling market would slip further.
- The 3.7x 30-minute return is already spent; it reads as a pump that is now rolling over.

If the desk overrode this, the most defensible setup would be a $5 ticket, a 20% stop, and a 15-minute hold, but I would not recommend it. Skipping costs nothing.
memos.scout:
The honest case for buying HOOKER is weak, and I'd recommend skipping it.

What the brief shows in its favor: the coin is alive, classed ORGANIC, with no airdrop dump seen, 318 buyers on the curve, and 2,095 buyers versus 1,769 sellers over the last 15 minutes. Net flow was slightly positive (+19.3 SOL), and the 30-minute return is +372%, so it has run hard.

What argues against it, and it outweighs the above: the last 15 minutes returned -10.8%, the price is 38.5% below its 30-minute high, and sellers are taking profit. Sell-to-buy ratio in the first two minutes after graduation was 1.12, and 75.6% of curve volume came from bundled buys, which is a bot-driven signature rather than broad demand. The launch bot was present, and the top 3 curve holders hold 14.9%. The pool is thin at 157.75 SOL, so a $20 round trip would eat 1.4-5.1% before any move. Momentum has already rolled over, and the base rate for buying a coin in this state 30-115 minutes after graduation is roughly a 20% loss per trade.

No credible case says real demand is here and will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. Skip.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss here is insider distribution. The curve shows bundle_share 0.7561, meaning about three-quarters of curve activity came through bundled wallets, and top3_share 0.1492 with completer_share 0.2435 suggests a coordinated group that graduated the coin and is positioned to sell into retail. The first 2 minutes after graduation had a launch_bot_present flag and a sell_to_buy_ratio of 1.12, so sellers were already matching buyers early. Over the last 15 minutes, sells (1294.58 SOL) nearly equaled buys (1313.87), net flow was just 19.3 SOL, and return was -10.8% from a 30-minute run of +372%, a 38.5% drawdown from the high. Pool depth of 157.75 SOL is thin, so a $20 ticket plus 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs can be absorbed by a small move. I'd skip.
